newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia firefighters win pay increases - paper.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia firefighters win pay increases - paper.

text.p: An arbitration panel awarded Philadelphia firefighters a four-year contract with pay raises every year, including a four percent rise immediately, Philadelphia Inquirer reported Tuesday.
Future pay increases will be four percent next year, followed by a three percent and a four percent rise in each of the following years.

The total cost of the raises will be about $233 million over four years, and Mayor Ed Rendell said he has not yet identified how to pay for $128 million of that total. But the mayor said he expects careful management of the budget will close the gap.
The panel's award mirrors similar raises granted the city's police and non-uniformed workers earlier this year.
